pull.title: wallet: Remove `CWalletTx::fTimeReceivedIsTxTime`
pull.body: `CWalletTx::fTimeReceivedIsTxTime` is no longer used and can be removed. This additionally allows the removal of the `upgraded_txs` loop in `LoadWallet`.

events.message:
wallet: Remove unused fTimeReceivedIsTxTime

fTimeReceivedIsTxTime has been unused unused since 0.3.24

events.body:
ACK https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32768/commits/9eb2c82e7c911a066781d67e6846cf6bbbaba6e9

`fTimeReceivedIsTxTime` has had no functional impact since it was removed in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/commit/471426fb3b2c2fa37640c03819c4f7be69ba8301#diff-286fedc8ff8f47bca92c7024d2c75272aa5bcfd733379eac1555e6036528d6b1

comments.body: I find it slightly weird that boolean was used to set an unsigned int.
Is there a possibility that sometime in the future we stop serialising and unserialising dummy values?
Interesting that `v0.3.16` is not present in the tags, might have been buggy for which this undoing was needed.
Looks fine to me to remove because `fTimeReceivedIsTxTime` is not really used in the wallet codebase at present, so I see no point in writing this upgraded transaction back.
Not with the way that stuff is serialized into the wallet.
I think if we ever started using the SQLite database as a relational database instead of as a key-value store as @achow101 has suggestd in the past, adding and removing fields will be neater.
